outline:
介紹含碳化合物的命名、結構與性質的基本概念。課程重點在反應機構、合成、立體化學、化學分析及儀器分析方法。
Fundamentals of structure and properties of carbon compounds. Emphasis on reaction mechanisms, synthesis, stereochemistry, as well as chemical and spectroscopic methods of analysis.
schedule:
1. Structure and Bonding
2. Polar Covalent Bonds: Acids and Bases
3. Organic compounds: Alkanes and Their Stereochemistry
4. Organic compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry
5. Stereochemistry at Tetrahedral Centers
6. An overview of Organic Reactions
7. Middle Examination
8. Alkenes: Structures and Reactivity
9. Alkenes: Reactions and Synthesis
10. Alkynes: An Introduction to Organic Synthesis
11. Organic Halides
12. Reactions of Alkyl Halides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
13. Structure Determination: Mass Spectroscopy and Infrared Spectroscopy
14. Structure Determination: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
15. Conjugated Compounds and Ultraviolet Spectroscopy
16. Benzene and Aromaticity
scorePolicy: 出席及上課情形，實施作業、二~四次左右之月考、期中考、期末考。
